text:
```yaml
name: Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://just.systems/install.sh | sh -s -- --yes
          echo "$HOME/.just/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Run just check
        run: just check

      - name: Run just test-all-features
        run: just test-all-features

      - name: Run just conformance
        run: just conformance
```
